'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|So a birdie told me the driver is determined and is looking for a new employer. I doubt the idiot realizes all the consequences of such a transition. In any case, I never even gave him that option anyway! The only lead I've confirmed now is about Peacekeeper. You should go to him and remind him that we have common interests with him! Make him remember who his key partner is.}}

==Requirements== 
* Unlocks 6 hours after completion of [[Hindsight 20/20]]

==Objectives==
* Sell any 75 items to [[Peacekeeper]]

==Rewards==
* +14,600 [[EXP]]
* [[Skier]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.02'''</font>
* 900 Euros
** 945 Euros with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 1,035 Euros with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 2× [[Intelligence folder]]
{{quote|Peacekeeper is a forward thinker, even if he wants to seem like a simple hustler. He won't dare to go against me now.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to sell any 75 items to [[Peacekeeper]], with the exception of [[ammunition]].

The sales amount display may not always update immediately. A game restart forces a refresh.
